C0345.title: Jiangxi Netizen Penalized for Bulk Purchasing Virtual Phone Numbers to Register and Sell App Accounts for Illegal Profit
C0345.summary: In August 2025, the Cybersecurity Bureau of China's Ministry of Public Security reported an illegal internet-account trading case handled by Ji'an cyber police in Jiangxi. Luo purchased large quantities of virtual phone numbers to register more than 4,000 accounts on a specific app and sold them to unspecified buyers; public security authorities imposed confiscation of illegal gains, a fine, and administrative detention.
